stem.en: The position-time graph of a vehicle is a flat line at 40 m, parallel to the time axis. What does it tell you about the vehicle?

text.en: It moves at a constant velocity of 40 m/s.

feedback.en: A flat line means the position does not change. A vehicle moving at 40 m/s would have a steep line.

text.en: It is at rest, 40 m from the origin.

feedback.en: Right. The position stays 40 m at every instant, so the vehicle does not move.
Then the position would rise by 40 m each second, and the line would slope up.

explanation.en: A flat line on a position-time graph means the position does not change with time. The vehicle is at rest at 40 m from the origin.

hints.en: Does the position change as time goes on?
